name: io.github.infileap/teps
title: TEPS
description: A host-independent microkernel with a set of organs behind one protocol. The kernel owns integrity, not truth; every refusal is a value with a retry flag, and the whole chain is replayable.

io.github.infileap/teps.note: There is no published package: TEPS is built from source with the Go toolchain vendored inside this repository (tools/install_go.sh). This file therefore declares the server's identity and transport, and docs/CLIENTS.md carries the exact launch command. A package entry here would name a registry that does not hold this project, which is the 'looks like it worked' failure in manifest form.
